Resources

The papers, open datasets, and software behind the Open Performance Data Initiative (OPDI) — together with the open-source ecosystem the initiative is built upon.

Publications

Peer-reviewed papers and open datasets underpinning the OPDI and the PRC Data Challenges.

JOAS
2026

Paper

Aircraft Fuel Burn Estimation: The EUROCONTROL PRC 2025 Data Challenge

J. Sun, E. Spinielli, M. Strohmeier

Journal of Open Aviation Science, vol. 4, no. 3

Describes the dataset behind the 2025 PRC Data Challenge, merging ACARS fuel telemetry crowd-sourced through airframes.io with Automatic Dependent Surveillance–Broadcast (ADS-B) trajectory data from the OpenSky Network (OSN).

Zenodo
2026

Dataset

Aircraft Fuel Burn Estimation Data Challenge

J. Sun, E. Spinielli, M. Strohmeier

Zenodo

The open dataset used in the 2025 PRC Data Challenge.

JOAS
2025

Paper

Aircraft Takeoff Weight Estimation: The EUROCONTROL PRC 2024 Data Challenge

E. Spinielli, J. Sun, M. Strohmeier, X. Olive, Q. Goens, R. Koelle, A. Tart, J. Fitzgerald

Journal of Open Aviation Science, vol. 3, no. 2

Introduces the 2024 PRC Data Challenge and the open dataset used to develop models estimating an aircraft’s actual takeoff weight.

4TU
2025

Dataset

Dataset for EUROCONTROL PRC 2024 Data Challenge on Aircraft Take-off Weight Estimation

J. Sun, E. Spinielli, X. Olive, M. Strohmeier

4TU.ResearchData, version 2

The open dataset used in the 2024 PRC Data Challenge.

SID
2024

Paper

The Open Performance Data Initiative: A Foundation Supporting the European Open Science Alliance for ATM Research

Q. Goens, R. Koelle, E. Spinielli, T. Bolić, A. Cook, M. Strohmeier

SESAR Innovation Days 2024

The foundational OPDI paper. Applies a conceptual trajectory reduction approach to publicly available crowd-sourced ADS-B data, producing flight events, measurements, and flight lists covering 33.9 million flights from January 2022 to July 2024.

SID
2023

Paper

Roadmap for a European Open Science Alliance for ATM Research

T. Bolić, A. Cook, R. Koelle, E. Spinielli, Q. Goens, M. Strohmeier

SESAR Innovation Days 2023

Identifies open data as a key ingredient for reproducible Air Traffic Management (ATM) research and postulates the roadmap towards an Open Science Alliance that the OPDI builds upon.

OPDI Software

Open-source projects created and maintained by the Performance Review Commission (PRC) as part of the initiative.

Python

OPDI

A pip-installable Python package for processing OSN aviation data through modular ETL pipelines. This is the code underpinning the OPDI datasets — see the Methodology for how each dataset is derived.

Repository · Documentation

Python

HexAeroPy

Determines the airports, runways, taxiways, and stands used by a flight from its coordinates alone. Developed for small-scale applications of the OPDI runway-detection approach.

Repository

Open-Source Foundations

The OPDI would not be possible without the wider open aviation software community. These projects are used throughout the data pipeline and the methodologies.

Python MIT

traffic

A toolbox for processing and analysing air traffic data. Used for trajectory filtering and cleaning.

Repository · Documentation

Python LGPL-3.0

OpenAP

The open model for aircraft performance and emissions, by Dr. Junzi Sun of TU Delft. Used to classify state vectors into flight phases when deriving flight events.

Repository · Documentation

Python LGPL-3.0

pyopensky

The Python interface to the OSN database, providing access to state vectors and historical trajectories via the REST API and Trino.

Repository · Documentation

Python LGPL-3.0

fastmeteo

A fast tool for obtaining meteorological data along flight trajectories. Used to associate weather information with trajectory points.

Repository

Contributing

If you maintain an open-source project that builds on OPDI data, or would like to contribute to one of ours, we would like to hear from you. Contact us at pru-support@eurocontrol.int.
